APPROVE
`InScript` drops to roughly 2 and each extracted iterator stays well under 15. `AddRange` enumerates the deferred iterators straight away, so site order and contents are unchanged. One caveat: the source wasn't available here, so I could only check the build from the diff, and the new helpers' parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) must match what `InScript`'s locals actually are.
